findings.summary: Typed task targets remain incomplete: Task 20 omits creation of lease.mjs and lease.test.mjs, Task 15b omits its separate writer-function migration, rollback and test, Task 14 omits maintainer.env and env-refs.test.mjs changes, and Task 11 omits creating the allowlist that Task 15b declares as a modification, leaving required implementation work outside the declared targets.

The writer-function migration requires PUBLIC EXECUTE to exist before revoking it, but every refresh replays all migrations without restoring pg_catalog privileges, so the second refresh—and the first after support performs the revocations—will fail.

Task 26's typed Files list omits creation of supabase/setup/rehearsal-fixture.sql and modifications to apply-migrations.mjs and its test, although its execution steps require those changes, leaving the declared task targets incomplete.
